runs.name: Skyline Builders Group Holding Limited; Nasdaq KAZR since 2026-06-17, formerly SKBL (IPO 2025-01-23), SEC CIK 0002031009, Cayman Islands, Form 20-F, fiscal year to March 31, US GAAP in US dollars with Hong Kong-dollar operations; Approved Public Works Contractor doing road and drainage civil engineering in Hong Kong through Kin Chiu Engineering and Kin Chiu Development, mostly as subcontractor; signed 2026-04-30 an unclosed business combination with Cove Kaz Capital Group and Kaz Resources (Kaz Critical Minerals LLP, a Kazakhstan tungsten venture), and bought two Nevada exploration properties for $136,000 in August 2026

runs.box: OUT AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$1.96** (KAZR close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged). Shares built by hand from the filings (`cover_shares.py` failed with a 404 for this 20-F filer; `tools/run.py` found FY2023 and FY2024 only, share basis stale): **17,942,094** ordinary (15,947,094 Class A and 1,995,000 Class B at 20 votes, 2026-08-10), **101,431,756** on a nominal-exercise basis (adding 47,326,026 Series A preferred convertible one for one, 35,413,636 pre-funded warrants and a 750,000 vested award; a CONVENTION of the run), about **150.1M** fully diluted; market value $35.2M ordinary, $198.8M nominal-exercise, about $294M fully diluted. Sovereign **4.519%** (HKD, HKSAR Government 20-year benchmark 20GB4503001, Hong Kong Government Bond Programme closing file, 2026-10-16; Hong Kong issues no 30-year and the protocol's table has no HKD row; the HKMA statistics API refused the request). Read from the FY2026 20-F (0001213900-26-090838, filed 2026-08-17 after an NT 20-F) and its 20-F/A (0001213900-26-092307, "clerical data entry errors" and iXBRL), the FY2025 20-F (0001213900-25-073107), the 424B4 (0001213900-25-006549), the F-1 for share history, the six 425s of 2026 and every 6-K from 2025-01-24 to 2026-08-17. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 4, 3.D and 5. The 20-F names no rival; none read (Q2 not reached). **Q1 OUT** **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**: what a share buys today is a start-up. A closing condition of the Transaction Agreement of 2026-04-30 is that the company "shall have disposed" of "its Hong Kong legacy business" and have no operations in Hong Kong or China (6-K 0001213900-26-049689); the 425 of 2026-08-17 states the new controllers' "goal to divest of the legacy Asian construction business"; each share converts one for one into PubCo, owner of 70% of the undeveloped Severniy Katpar tungsten deposits in Kazakhstan, no production, the feasibility study begun August 2026, development put at about $1.1B, no target statements filed; beside it two early-stage Nevada claims bought for $136,000; Item 3.D: if the deal fails the company "may have limited or no operating business". After the stop, facts recorded, not judged: $7M of new investors' money retired the founder company's 18.5M shares on the day control was sold; repeated placements with warrants, preferreds and convertible notes, issuance costs $3.1M of $17.8M and $8.0M of $23.9M; a $43.2M stake in the counterparty bought for $20M and written up by $23.4M, the whole of FY2026's reported $9.1M profit; a $23.1M loan to Cove Kaz under a facility of up to $45M; $46.2M of escrowed placement cash; receivables from $2.1M to $10.0M in two years on flat sales, then an $8.2M credit-loss charge; 3M shares to the executive chairman and 3M more at closing; director and CFO resignations; Dablam LP 71.4% of votes, its principals not identified; a late 20-F, an amendment, material weaknesses; a "commodity super cycle" forecast in the deal release. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost $M FY2023 to FY2026: 1.5, (6.79), (4.93), (5.35), mean (3.89) (FY2022 in no filing read; a four-year window); revenue flat at $44.6M to $50.1M, gross margin 6.3% to 6.6%; no-growth case about $(73)M all-equity, $(54)M with $19.07M net cash, $(86)M equity-only; **value range nil to nil**, no case earning the floor at any positive price (a negative value reported as nil, a CONVENTION of the run); **fair nil all-equity and equity-only**, not armed (box not OUT at Q7 or IN). Balance sheets FY2022 to FY2026 only (five, short of eight to ten). Contamination declared by the analyst: the SKK commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names in the status listing, and the memory index's queue summary; none used. Commits caf5b9d1 (template), dfe767a9 (step 0), d673f879 (balance sheets, Q1), 395adb7e (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` 0 problems; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_adjacent.py`, 13 fragments beside an id, none outside its row (the paragraph-level `dispatcher_check.py` flagged 17 fragments, every one a filing quotation sharing a paragraph with an id, read and cleared); no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB (filings in the ignored cache). check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): Q1 does not say whether the business judged is the one filed today or the one a signed, unclosed deal makes it; Q7 has no rule for a negative value; no HKD row in the sovereign table. Could not get: FY2022 owner cash, the principals behind Dablam LP, any interim report after 2026-03-31.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1 (Skyline Builders Group Holding, Nasdaq KAZR formerly SKBL; Hong Kong road and drainage subcontractor whose signed, unclosed Transaction Agreement of 2026-04-30 with Cove Kaz requires the Hong Kong business to be disposed of and turns each share into PubCo, owner of 70% of an undeveloped Kazakhstan tungsten deposit with no production and no target statements filed, beside two early-stage Nevada claims bought for $136,000; a start-up by kind. Facts recorded, not judged: the founder company's 18.5M shares retired with new investors' money on the day control was sold; heavy issuance through preferreds, warrants and convertible notes, about 150M fully diluted against 17.9M ordinary shares; FY2026 profit entirely a write-up of the counterparty stake; a $23.1M loan to the counterparty; a credit-loss charge on receivables that quadrupled on flat sales; a late 20-F, an amendment, material weaknesses. Computation beneath the stop: owner cash mean $(3.89)M, value range nil to nil, fair nil all-equity and equity-only, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: Q1 on a business a signed deal will replace, a negative value in Q7, no HKD sovereign row.)
